title: Liability, Medical Payments and Uninsured Motorist Limits by Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package
content:
Every Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is written on one of six coverage packages, and the package fixes the limits of the liability, medical payments and uninsured motorist coverages carried on the policy. The limits below are the package's own; they are expressed in US dollars.

## Limits by package

| Coverage (USD) | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bodily injury liability, per person | 50000 | 50000 | 100000 | 100000 | 250000 | 250000 |
| Bodily injury liability, per accident | 100000 | 100000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Property damage liability, per accident | 25000 | 50000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 250000 |
| Medical payments, per injured person | 0 (not included) | 1000 | 2000 | 5000 | 5000 | 10000 |
| Uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury, per person | 50000 | 50000 | 100000 | 100000 | 250000 | 250000 |
| Uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury, per accident | 100000 | 100000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Uninsured motorist property damage, per accident | 25000 | 25000 | 50000 | 50000 | 100000 | 100000 |
| Deductible on an uninsured motorist property damage payment | 250 | 250 | 250 | 200 | 200 | 0 |

## Reading the schedule

- A medical payments limit of 0 means the coverage is not included on that package: Cardinal Auto Essential carries no medical payments coverage.
- The uninsured motorist property damage deductible is the amount applied to an uninsured motorist property damage payment. On Cardinal Auto Premier it is 0, so no deductible applies to such a payment.
- Bodily injury limits read in pairs: the per-person figure is the most paid for one injured person, the per-accident figure the most paid for all injured people in one accident. On Cardinal Auto Standard, for example, those are 100000 per person and 300000 per accident.

## Package comparison points

- Cardinal Auto Essential and Cardinal Auto Basic share the same bodily injury and uninsured motorist bodily injury limits; they differ in property damage liability (25000 against 50000) and in medical payments (none against 1000).
- Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier share the same bodily injury limits; Cardinal Auto Premier carries the higher property damage liability limit (250000 against 100000), the higher medical payments limit (10000 against 5000) and no uninsured motorist property damage deductible.
